comment: -p AMWI is the isotopically aware molecular weight, which uses the
isotope number as the mass of the atom. Pins two things: that an
isotopic atom contributes at all, and that its Hydrogens are counted.
Both were previously dropped - ether_13c used to report 44.034 rather
than 47.058, short by its three Hydrogens.

comment: Exocyclic imines on aromatic rings become amines when a ring N-H can take the double
bond: next to the carbon, para to it, or round a benzo ring (acridine), and several
imines in a ring when each has an N-H. The neg_ entries must be unchanged: more N-H
than imines (a choice of tautomer), no N-H, a substituted ring N next to the imine

The ring hydroxyisoxazole is converted by its own rule, as before.
